response: According to the retrieved matches, continuous intravenous infusion of low-concentration epinephrine does not impair uterine blood flow in pregnant ewes. In fact, the study found that intravenous infusion of ≤ 1.67 micrograms/min epinephrine altered neither maternal hemodynamics nor uterine blood flow in gravid ewes. This suggests that continuous intravenous infusion of epinephrine in local anesthetic solutions is safe if the epidural catheter should enter a blood vessel during the infusion, at least to the extent that sheep data can be extrapolated to humans.
